{{Infobox auto}}

'''Bokguk''' is a pufferfish soup that heals {{Value|Bokguk|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Conduit Power}} for {{Value|Bokguk|duration|effect=Conduit Power}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bokguk.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Dried Kelp|Dried kelp]], a carrot, a raw [[pufferfish]], a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], a [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]] and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a pufferfish unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating bokguk takes {{Value|Bokguk|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Bokguk|heals}} and gives Conduit Power for {{Value|Bokguk|duration|effect=Conduit Power|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_1.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
